articles.title_en: Evaluating non-clairvoyant dynamic mechanisms: Theory and experiment
articles.title_cn: 评估非透视动力机制：理论与实验
articles.abstract_en: We study dynamic mechanism design in non-clairvoyant environments, where sellers cannot forecast future demand and buyers hold private information. Using two laboratory experiments, we evaluate two non-clairvoyant mechanisms: the dynamic maximin-optimal non-clairvoyant mechanism (DM, Mirrokni et al., 2020) and the repeated static optimal mechanism (RS, Myerson, 1981). Experiment 1 compares DM and RS between demand-distribution scenarios and shows that non-clairvoyant mechanisms perform as intended: DM either outperforms or underperforms RS depending on the scenario, consistent with theory. Building on these results, Experiment 2 examines the optimal clairvoyant mechanism (OC) and a different implementation of DM. In surprising contrast to theory, OC using full information performs no better than the non-clairvoyant mechanisms, while DM performs equally well across implementation forms. Our results highlight the practical importance of non-clairvoyant mechanisms as implementable approaches to dynamic auction design in uncertain markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究非透视环境中的动态机制设计，在这种环境中，卖方无法预测未来需求，而买方持有私人信息。使用 二 实验室实验，我们评估 二 非千里眼机制：动态最大最小最优非千里眼机制（DM，Mirrokni 等人，2020）和重复静态最优机制（RS，Myerson，1981）。实验 1 比较了需求分配场景中的 DM 和 RS，并表明非透视机制按预期执行：根据场景，DM 表现优于或低于 RS，这与理论一致。基于这些结果，实验 2 检查了最佳透视机制 (OC) 和 DM 的不同实现。与理论相反，使用完整信息的 OC 的表现并不比非透视机制更好，而 DM 在各种实现形式中表现同样出色。我们的结果强调了非透视机制作为不确定市场中动态拍卖设计的可行方法的实际重要性。

articles.title_en: Compellingness in Nash implementation
articles.title_cn: 纳什实施的说服力
articles.abstract_en: A social choice function (SCF) is said to be Nash implementable (in pure strategies) if there exists a mechanism in which every pure-strategy Nash equilibrium induces outcomes specified by the SCF. The main objective of this paper is to assess the impact of considering mixed-strategy equilibria in Nash implementation. We define compelling Nash implementation as a case where the implementing mechanism possesses a pure-strategy equilibrium that strictly Pareto dominates any undesired mixed-strategy equilibrium. We show that if the finite environment and the SCF to be implemented jointly satisfy what we call Condition COM, then we can construct a finite mechanism which compellingly implements the SCF. We also identify a class of voting environments that satisfies Condition COM, extend Condition COM to accommodate social choice correspondences, and explore a preliminary stability-based justification for the implementing mechanism. Our mechanism has several desirable features: transfers are completely dispensable; only finite mechanisms are considered; integer games are not invoked; and agents’ attitudes toward risk do not affect implementation.
articles.abstract_cn: 如果存在一种机制，其中每个纯策略纳什均衡都会导致 SCF 指定的结果，则称社会选择函数 (SCF) 是纳什可实现的（在纯策略中）。本文的主要目的是评估纳什实施中考虑混合策略均衡的影响。我们将引人注目的纳什实施定义为实施机制拥有纯策略均衡的情况，该均衡严格帕累托支配任何不期望的混合策略均衡。我们证明，如果有限环境和要实现的 SCF 共同满足我们所说的条件 COM，那么我们就可以构造一个强制实现 SCF 的有限机制。我们还确定了一类满足条件 COM 的投票环境，扩展条件 COM 以适应社会选择对应关系，并为实施机制探索基于稳定性的初步理由。我们的机制有几个理想的特点：转账是完全可有可无的；仅考虑有限机制；不调用整数游戏；代理人对风险的态度并不影响执行。

articles.title_en: Istanbul flower auction: The need for speed
articles.title_cn: 伊斯坦布尔花卉拍卖：速度的需要
articles.abstract_en: We examine a unique auction format used in the Istanbul flower market, which could transform into either Dutch or English auction depending on bidders’ bidding behaviors. By introducing a time cost that reduces the value of a perishable good as time passes, we explore how this hybrid auction format accommodates the desire for speed via an adaptive starting price. We show that the Istanbul Flower Auction outperforms both the Dutch and English auctions in terms of the auctioneer’s utility. With numerical analysis, we also illustrate the Istanbul Flower Auction’s superiority in terms of social welfare and auction duration. Our results highlight the critical role of auction design in improving welfare when the duration of the auction process matters.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了伊斯坦布尔花卉市场使用的独特拍卖形式，根据投标人的出价行为，该形式可以转变为荷兰式或英式拍卖。通过引入时间成本，随着时间的推移，易腐烂商品的价值会降低，我们探讨了这种混合拍卖格式如何通过自适应起始价格来满足对速度的渴望。我们表明，就拍卖师的效用而言，伊斯坦布尔花卉拍卖会优于荷兰和英国拍卖。通过数值分析，我们还说明了伊斯坦布尔花卉拍卖在社会福利和拍卖持续时间方面的优越性。我们的结果凸显了当拍卖过程的持续时间很重要时，拍卖设计在改善福利方面的关键作用。

articles.title_en: Welfare properties of the Taiwan mechanism
articles.title_cn: 台湾机制的福利属性
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes the welfare properties of the mechanism Taiwan uses to match students to high schools. I study the Taiwan mechanism under a theoretical model where students share the same ordinal rankings, and a single lottery determines schools’ preferences. In this setting, all Taiwan mechanisms ex ante weakly Pareto dominate deferred acceptance for strategizing students. Additionally, in my model, there always exists a Taiwan mechanism that provides greater welfare than deferred acceptance to students who do not strategize. Using Cambridge Public School data, I demonstrate that the Taiwan mechanism outperforms deferred acceptance for a range of deduction rules.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了台湾用于将学生与高中匹配的机制的福利属性。我在一个理论模型下研究了台湾的机制，即学生享有相同的顺序排名，并且一次抽签决定学校的偏好。在这种情况下，所有台湾机制都在事前弱帕累托主导了对制定战略的学生的延迟接受。此外，在我的模型中，始终存在一种台湾机制，为没有策略的学生提供比延迟录取更大的福利。我使用剑桥公立学校的数据证明，台湾机制在一系列扣除规则方面优于延期接受机制。

articles.title_en: When is it (im)possible to respect all individuals’ preferences under uncertainty?
articles.title_cn: 在不确定的情况下什么时候（不可能）能够尊重所有个人的偏好？
articles.abstract_en: When aggregating Subjective Expected Utility preferences, the Pareto principle leads to an impossibility result unless the individuals have a common belief. This paper examines the source of this impossibility in more detail by considering the aggregation of a general class of incomplete preferences that can represent gradual ambiguity perceptions. Our result shows that the planner cannot avoid ignoring some individuals unless there is a probability distribution that all individuals agree is most plausible. This means that even if individuals have similar ambiguity perceptions, the impossibility persists as long as some individual’s most plausible belief differs even slightly from that of others.
articles.abstract_cn: 当汇总主观预期效用偏好时，帕累托原则会导致不可能的结果，除非个人有共同的信念。本文通过考虑可以代表逐渐模糊感知的一类不完整偏好的聚合，更详细地探讨了这种不可能性的根源。我们的结果表明，规划者不可避免地会忽略某些个体，除非存在一个所有个体都认为最合理的概率分布。这意味着，即使个人有类似的模糊性认知，只要某些人最合理的信念与其他人的信念略有不同，这种不可能性就会持续存在。

articles.title_en: Failing to correctly aggregate signals
articles.title_cn: 未能正确聚合信号
articles.abstract_en: Individuals fail to recognize that two weak positive signals of a rare event together constitute strong evidence for the event. We demonstrate the dramatic effect of replacing Bayesian aggregation of signals with commonly used aggregation procedures in a simple model of opinion formation and a model of strategic voting.
articles.abstract_cn: 人们未能认识到 二 罕见事件的微弱积极信号共同构成了该事件的有力证据。我们在简单的意见形成模型和策略投票模型中展示了用常用聚合程序代替贝叶斯信号聚合的显着效果。

articles.title_en: Noncooperative oligopoly in markets with a continuum of traders and a strongly connected set of commodities: A limit theorem
articles.title_cn: 具有连续交易者和一组强关联商品的市场中的非合作寡头垄断：极限定理
articles.abstract_en: We consider a mixed version of the Shapley window model, where large traders are represented as atoms and small traders are represented by an atomless part. In the original spirit of Cournot (1838), we partially replicate the mixed exchange economy by increasing the number of atoms, without affecting the atomless part, and ensuring that the measure space of agents remains finite. Our main theorem shows that any sequence of Cournot-Nash allocations of the strategic market games associated with the partial replications of the exchange economy has a limit point for each trader and that the assignment determined by these limit points is a Walras allocation of the original economy. Instead of relying on restrictive assumptions on the characteristics of atoms, as in Busetto et al. (2017), our limit theorem relies on the characteristics of agents in the atomless part and their endogenous price-taking behavior.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑沙普利窗口模型的混合版本，其中大型交易者由原子表示，小型交易者由无原子部分表示。本着古诺（1838）的原始精神，我们通过增加原子数量来部分复制混合交换经济，而不影响无原子部分，并确保代理的测度空间保持有限。我们的主要定理表明，与交换经济的部分复制相关的战略市场博弈的任何古诺-纳什分配序列对于每个交易者都有一个极限点，并且由这些极限点确定的分配是原始经济的瓦尔拉斯分配。而不是像 Busetto 等人那样依赖对原子特性的限制性假设。 (2017)，我们的极限定理依赖于无原子部分的代理特征及其内生价格接受行为。

articles.title_en: Approximating competitive equilibrium by Nash welfare
articles.title_cn: 通过纳什福利逼近竞争均衡
articles.abstract_en: We study the relationship between two central concepts in the allocation of divisible goods: competitive equilibrium (CE) and allocations that maximize Nash welfare, i.e., allocations where the weighted geometric mean of the utilities is maximal. When agents have homogeneous concave utility functions, these concepts coincide: the classical Eisenberg–Gale convex program that maximizes Nash welfare over feasible allocations yields a competitive equilibrium. However, they diverge for non–homogeneous utilities. From a computational perspective, maximizing Nash welfare amounts to solving a convex program for any concave utility functions, whereas computing CE becomes PPAD-hard already for separable piecewise linear concave (SPLC) utilities. We introduce the concept of Gale-substitute utility functions, an analogue of the weak gross substitutes (WGS) property for the so-called Gale demand system. For Gale-substitutes utilities, we show that any allocation maximizing Nash welfare provides an approximate-CE with surprisingly strong guarantees, where every agent gets at least half the maximum utility they can get at any CE, and is approximately envy-free. Gale-substitutes include utility functions where computing CE is PPAD hard, such as all separable concave utilities and the previously studied non-separable class of Leontief-free utilities. We introduce a broad new class of utility functions called generalized network utilities based on the generalized flow model. This class includes SPLC and Leontief-free utilities, and we show that all such utilities are Gale-substitutes. Conversely, although some agents may get much higher utility at a Nash welfare maximizing allocation than at a CE, we show a ‘price of anarchy’ type result: for general concave utilities, every CE achieves at least (1/e)1/e > 0.69 fraction of the maximum Nash welfare, and this factor is tight.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了可分割商品分配中 二 中心概念之间的关系：竞争均衡（CE）和最大化纳什福利的分配，即效用的加权几何平均值最大的分配。当代理人具有齐次凹效用函数时，这些概念是一致的：经典的艾森伯格-盖尔凸计划在可行的分配上最大化纳什福利，产生竞争均衡。然而，它们对于非同质公用事业存在分歧。从计算的角度来看，最大化纳什福利相当于求解任何凹效用函数的凸规划，而计算 CE 对于可分离分段线性凹 (SPLC) 效用来说已经变得 PPAD 困难。我们引入了 Gale 替代效用函数的概念，它类似于所谓的 Gale 需求系统的弱总替代 (WGS) 属性。对于盖尔替代效用，我们表明任何最大化纳什福利的分配都提供了近似-CE，并具有令人惊讶的强大保证，其中每个智能体至少获得了他们在任何 CE 中可以获得的最大效用的一半，并且大约是无嫉妒的。 Gale 替代品包括计算 CE 难以进行 PPAD 的效用函数，例如所有可分离凹效用和先前研究的不可分离类 Leontief-free 效用。我们引入了一类广泛的新效用函数，称为基于广义流模型的广义网络效用。此类包括无 SPLC 和 Leontief 的实用程序，并且我们证明所有此类实用程序都是 Gale 的替代品。相反，尽管一些代理人在纳什福利最大化分配时可能比在 CE 时获得更高的效用，但我们显示了“无政府状态的价格”类型的结果：对于一般凹效用，每个 CE 至少实现了最大纳什福利的 (1/e)1/e > 0.69 分数，并且这个因子是紧的。

articles.title_en: Neural correlates of interactions between adaptive learning and hierarchical reasoning in repeated strategic games
articles.title_cn: 重复策略博弈中自适应学习和分层推理之间相互作用的神经关联
articles.abstract_en: Repeated strategic interactions with consistent partners involve both adaptive learning and hierarchical reasoning. Hybrid models that incorporate reasoning into adaptive learning paradigms have been proposed to capture these processes and their interactions at the behavioral level. Here, we employ model-based functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) to investigate the neural computations underlying decisions in repeated strategic interactions between two players using 11–20 money request games. A hybrid model explains medial prefrontal cortex activity more accurately than pure adaptive learning models. Additionally, we find that regions such as the rostral anterior cingulate, dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, right temporoparietal junction, precuneus, and anterior insula correlate with prediction error signals generated by adaptive, simulated adaptive, and sophisticated learning from the hybrid model. Together, our findings provide novel neural-level support for the interplay between adaptive learning and hierarchical reasoning in a repeated game with fixed partners.
articles.abstract_cn: 与一致的合作伙伴进行重复的战略互动涉及适应性学习和层次推理。人们提出了将推理纳入自适应学习范式的混合模型，以捕获这些过程及其在行为层面上的相互作用。在这里，我们采用基于模型的功能磁共振成像 (fMRI) 来研究使用 11-20 金钱请求游戏的 二 玩家之间重复策略交互中决策背后的神经计算。混合模型比纯自适应学习模型更准确地解释内侧前额叶皮层活动。此外，我们发现头侧前扣带回、背外侧前额叶皮层、右颞顶交界处、楔前叶和前岛叶等区域与混合模型的自适应、模拟自适应和复杂学习生成的预测误差信号相关。总之，我们的研究结果为与固定伙伴的重复游戏中自适应学习和分层推理之间的相互作用提供了新颖的神经水平支持。

articles.title_en: Guilt and fairness
articles.title_cn: 罪恶感与公平
articles.abstract_en: Guilt aversion and inequity aversion are two pivotal concepts in understanding human behavior in situations involving trust dynamics. Inequity aversion explains trustworthiness through a preference for fairness, as trustworthiness leads to more equitable distributions. Conversely, guilt aversion posits that people act to avoid the guilt associated with betraying others. As both preferences provide justifications for trustworthiness, distinguishing between them solely through observed behavior poses a significant challenge. In this work, I aim to disentangle the effects of guilt and inequity aversion to identify the main driver of pro-social behavior in a theory-driven experiment based on the Trust Game. I show theoretically that by increasing the stakes for the trustor, the two preferences have opposite predictions on trustworthiness. The experimental design, informed by this theory, features a doubling of the trustor’s payoffs. The results indicate that preferences for equality are the main determinants of trustworthiness. This further shows that inequality erodes trustworthiness and, consequently, trust.
articles.abstract_cn: 内疚厌恶和不平等厌恶是 二 理解涉及信任动态的情况下人类行为的关键概念。不平等厌恶通过对公平的偏好来解释可信性，因为可信性会导致更公平的分配。相反，内疚厌恶假设人们采取行动以避免与背叛他人相关的内疚感。由于这两种偏好都为可信度提供了理由，因此仅通过观察到的行为来区分它们构成了重大挑战。在这项工作中，我的目标是在基于信任游戏的理论驱动实验中理清内疚和不平等厌恶的影响，以确定亲社会行为的主要驱动因素。我从理论上证明，通过增加委托人的赌注，二 偏好对可信度有相反的预测。根据这一理论，实验设计的特点是委托人的收益加倍。结果表明，平等偏好是可信度的主要决定因素。这进一步表明，不平等会侵蚀可信度，从而侵蚀信任。

articles.title_en: Morality meets risk: What makes a good excuse for selfishness
articles.title_cn: 道德与风险：什么是自私的好借口
articles.abstract_en: Prior work finds that individuals are often less prosocial when they can exploit uncertainty as an excuse. In contrast to prior work that largely explores the relevance of excuses in the gain domain, this paper investigates the relevance of excuses in both the loss and gain domains. In our laboratory experiment, participants evaluated risky payoffs for themselves and their partners in either the gain or loss domain, with or without interpersonal trade-offs. We found that participants exhibited excuse-driven risk behaviors in both domains. We also documented significant individual heterogeneity in the degree of excuses, influenced by factors such as individuals’ risk preferences, beliefs about others’ risk preferences, and the size of the risk. We present a self-signaling model that incorporates self-image concerns to explain our experimental findings. We show that excuse-driven risk behavior arises because people misattribute their selfish behavior to risk preferences rather than a reduced level of altruism.
articles.abstract_cn: 先前的研究发现，当个人以不确定性为借口时，他们往往不太亲社会。与之前主要探讨借口在收益领域的相关性的工作相比，本文研究了借口在损失和收益领域的相关性。在我们的实验室实验中，参与者评估了自己及其合作伙伴在收益或损失领域的风险回报，无论是否进行人际权衡。我们发现参与者在这两个领域都表现出了借口驱动的风险行为。我们还记录了借口程度的显着个体异质性，其受到个人风险偏好、对其他人风险偏好的信念以及风险大小等因素的影响。我们提出了一个自我信号模型，其中包含自我形象问题来解释我们的实验结果。我们表明，借口驱动的风险行为的出现是因为人们将自己的自私行为错误地归因于风险偏好，而不是利他主义水平的降低。

articles.title_en: Representation in collective policymaking
articles.title_cn: 集体决策中的代表权
articles.abstract_en: We study a policy-motivated principal choosing a representative to bargain over one-dimensional policy in a collective body under majority rule. The representative’s ideology affects policy outcomes directly through their own proposal and indirectly by shaping the median’s expectations, determining which proposals pass. This creates a tradeoff: a representative close to the principal’s ideal point makes favorable proposals but permits extremist proposals to pass, while a more centrist representative constrains extremism by improving the median’s continuation value. We show that a wide range of principals strictly prefer representatives biased toward center rather than themselves. The optimal representative is unique for almost all principals, strictly increasing in the principal’s ideal point, and never biased away from center. We also study competitive representation with multiple principals choosing representatives.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个政策驱动的委托人选择一名代表在多数统治下的集体机构中就 一 维度的政策进行讨价还价。代表的意识形态通过他们自己的提案直接影响政策结果，并通过塑造中位数的预期来间接影响政策结果，从而决定哪些提案通过。这就产生了一种权衡：接近委托人理想点的代表会提出有利的提案，但允许极端主义提案通过，而更中间派的代表则通过提高中位数的连续值来限制极端主义。我们表明，许多校长严格地更喜欢偏向中间派而不是他们自己的代表。最佳代表对于几乎所有委托人来说都是唯一的，在委托人的理想点上严格递增，并且永远不会偏离中心。我们还研究了多位校长选择代表的竞争性代表。

articles.title_en: The quasi-prekernel for cooperative games
articles.title_cn: 合作博弈的准预内核
articles.abstract_en: The quasi-prekernel is a novel solution concept for cooperative games. It is a refinement of existing prebargaining set solutions, notably the reactive, semireactive, and Aumann-Davis-Maschler prebargaining sets. It contains the prekernel, and coincides with that solution on simple games except possibly on balanced simple games with all individual worths equal to zero. An axiomatic characterization based on reduced game properties is provided. The steady version, obtained by putting conditions on objecting and counterobjecting coalitions, is considered as well. Finally, by considering objecting and counterobjecting coalitions independent of specific players, the so-called excess prebargaining obtains, which is another novel solution concept.
articles.abstract_cn: 准预内核是合作博弈的一种新颖的解决方案概念。它是对现有预谈判集解决方案的改进，特别是反应式、半反应式和 Aumann-Davis-Maschler 预谈判集。它包含预内核，并且与简单游戏上的解决方案一致，但所有个人价值等于 零 的平衡简单游戏除外。提供了基于简化博弈属性的公理表征。通过对反对和反反对联盟施加条件而获得的稳定版本也被考虑。最后，通过考虑独立于特定参与者的反对和反反对联盟，获得了所谓的过度预谈判，这是另一个新颖的解决方案概念。

articles.title_en: The case for lobbying transparency
articles.title_cn: 游说透明度的案例
articles.abstract_en: Lobbying transparency regulations are hailed as a potential solution to concerns about the excessive influence of special interest groups (SIGs) over policymaking. I study how these regulations shape strategic interactions between voters, politicians and SIGs. By clarifying the process through which a policy was implemented, lobbying transparency helps voters hold politicians accountable and control the influence of SIGs. Ex-post, conditional on access, SIGs prefer to operate without lobbying transparency. Ex-ante, they may benefit from lobbying transparency because it redirects the voters’ blame towards politicians. However, lobbying transparency standards may ultimately hurt the electoral prospects of politicians and thus risk never being implemented, potentially explaining why voters’ demand for it remains unanswered.
articles.abstract_cn: 游说透明度法规被誉为解决特殊利益集团 (SIG) 对政策制定过度影响力问题的潜在解决方案。我研究这些法规如何塑造选民、政客和 SIG 之间的战略互动。通过澄清政策实施的过程，游说透明度有助于选民让政客承担责任并控制特别兴趣小组的影响力。事后，以准入为条件，特别兴趣小组更愿意在没有游说透明度的情况下运作。事前，他们可能会从游说透明度中受益，因为它将选民的指责转向政客。然而，游说透明度标准可能最终会损害政客的选举前景，从而面临永远无法实施的风险，这可能解释了为什么选民的要求仍未得到回应。

articles.title_en: River-sharing problem with floods
articles.title_cn: 洪水带来的河流共享问题
articles.abstract_en: International river basins are prone to droughts in some countries and floods in others. Water inflows from upstream neighbors benefit drought-stricken countries but harm flood-stricken countries. As a generalization of two existing river-sharing models (Ambec and Ehlers, 2008; Ambec and Sprumont, 2002), which do not capture the disutility of water inflow, we formulate the river-sharing problem with floods. We provide two characterizations of benefit-function profiles for which the downstream incremental distribution is the unique welfare distribution that satisfies both the upper and lower welfare bounds of river basin countries. We also propose a strategic bargaining process that yields this welfare distribution as a unique subgame-perfect equilibrium.
articles.abstract_cn: 国际河流流域在一些国家容易发生干旱，而在另一些国家则容易发生洪水。来自上游邻国的水流入有利于遭受干旱的国家，但损害了遭受洪水的国家。作为 二 现有河流共享模型（Ambec 和 Ehlers，2008；Ambec 和 Sprumont，2002）的推广，该模型没有捕捉到水流入的负效用，我们制定了洪水河流共享问题。我们提供了效益函数概况的 二 特征，其中下游增量分布是满足流域国家福利上限和下限的独特福利分布。我们还提出了一种战略讨价还价过程，该过程产生这种福利分配作为独特的子博弈完美均衡。

articles.title_en: The effect of exit rights on cost-based procurement contracts
articles.title_cn: 退出权对基于成本的采购合同的影响
articles.abstract_en: We analyze optimal procurement contracts when suppliers learn about project costs over time and retain an ex-post right to exit. In the first period, the firm observes a private signal on the likelihood of high costs; in the second, it learns the realized cost type and decides whether to continue or exercise its outside option. We show that when exit opportunities are sufficiently attractive, the optimal mechanism pools all first-period signals and reduces to a cost-plus contract, with payments tied only to realized, verifiable costs. Attempts to elicit cost forecasts ex-ante backfire: firms strategically under-report expectations, triggering exit in high-cost states and generating overruns. This provides a mechanism-based interpretation of cost overruns as failures of incentive design. Finally, we demonstrate that more generous outside options can raise procurement costs and lower firm profits, identifying conditions where limiting exit rights is ex-ante Pareto improving. (JEL D82, D86, H57)
articles.abstract_cn: 当供应商随着时间的推移了解项目成本并保留事后退出权时，我们会分析最佳采购合同。在 第一 期间，公司观察到有关高成本可能性的私人信号；在 第二 中，它了解已实现的成本类型并决定是否继续或行使其外部选项。我们表明，当退出机会足够有吸引力时，最优机制会汇集所有 第一 周期信号，并简化为成本加成合同，付款仅与已实现的、可验证的成本挂钩。事前进行成本预测的尝试适得其反：企业战略性地低报预期，引发高成本州的退出并产生超支。这提供了基于机制的成本超支解释为激励设计的失败。最后，我们证明，更慷慨的外部选择会提高采购成本并降低公司利润，并确定限制退出权是事前帕累托改进的条件。 (JEL D82、D86、H57)

articles.title_en: Reduced strategies and cognitive hierarchies in the extensive and normal form
articles.title_cn: 广泛和正常形式的减少策略和认知层次
articles.abstract_en: In a recent paper, Lin and Palfrey (2024) developed a theory of cognitive hierarchies (CH) in sequential games and observed that this solution concept is not reduced-normal-form invariant. In this paper I qualify and explain this observation. I show that the CH model is normal-form invariant, and that the differences arising from the application of the CH model to the reduced normal form depend only on how randomization by level-0 types is modeled. Indeed, while the uniform behavior strategy in the extensive form yields the uniform mixed strategy in the normal form, the latter does not correspond to the uniform randomization in the reduced normal form, because different reduced strategies may correspond to sets of equivalent strategies with different cardinalities. I also comment on (i) the invariance of the CH model to some transformations of the sequential game, and (ii) the independence of conditional beliefs about co-players’ level-types.
articles.abstract_cn: 在最近的一篇论文中，Lin 和 Palfrey (2024) 提出了顺序博弈中的认知层次 (CH) 理论，并观察到该解决方案概念不是简化正态形式不变式。在本文中，我限定并解释了这一观察结果。我证明了 CH 模型是正态形式不变的，并且 CH 模型应用于简化正态形式所产生的差异仅取决于如何对级别 0 类型的随机化进行建模。事实上，虽然扩展形式的统一行为策略产生了规范形式的统一混合策略，但后者并不对应于简化规范形式的均匀随机化，因为不同的简化策略可能对应于具有不同基数的等价策略集。我还评论了 (i) CH 模型对顺序游戏的某些转换的不变性，以及 (ii) 关于共同玩家关卡类型的条件信念的独立性。

articles.title_en: The effects of induced emotions on punishment and reward
articles.title_cn: 诱发情绪对惩罚和奖励的影响
articles.abstract_en: The ability to punish free-riders has been shown to sustain cooperation in social dilemma games. Those that engage in costly punishment are often those that are angry at observed contributions of their fellow group members. This paper abstracts from the effect of integral (i.e., related to the situation) emotions and explicitly studies the effect of incidental (i.e., unrelated to the situation) emotions. By inducing either positive or negative emotions we can causally investigate the effect of negative emotions on punishment or reward decisions in a one-shot public good game where personal and social interests are at odds. Our findings suggest that neither punishment nor reward per se are a function of induced (incidental) emotions. Induced emotions also do not have an effect on the probability to punish or reward. However, we find that conditionally on punishing, subjects that are induced to be in a negative mood punish group members significantly harsher than subjects who are induced to be in a positive mood. The handing out of rewards is not affected by induced moods.
articles.abstract_cn: 惩罚搭便车者的能力已被证明可以维持社会困境游戏中的合作。那些进行代价高昂的惩罚的人往往是那些对观察到的其他小组成员的贡献感到愤怒的人。本文抽象了整体（即与情境相关）情绪的影响，并明确研究了偶然（即与情境无关）情绪的影响。通过诱发积极或消极情绪，我们可以在个人利益和社会利益不一致的 一 公益游戏中因果性地研究消极情绪对惩罚或奖励决策的影响。我们的研究结果表明，惩罚和奖励本身都不是诱发（偶然）情绪的函数。诱发的情绪也不影响惩罚或奖励的概率。然而，我们发现，在惩罚的条件下，被诱导处于消极情绪的受试者对小组成员的惩罚明显比被诱导处于积极情绪的受试者更严厉。奖励的发放不受诱发情绪的影响。

articles.title_en: Efficient equilibrium in submodular global games of entry
articles.title_cn: 子模全局进入博弈的有效均衡
articles.abstract_en: We propose a global games approach to the standard two-stage entry game. The entry decisions in the first stage are strategic substitutes. The second-stage game of product market competition reflects a fundamental common value “market attractiveness” parameter, about which firms get private noisy signals. The main result establishes the selection of a unique equilibrium in the entry game, as noise vanishes, in cut-off strategies implying efficient entry. This provides a theoretical foundation for the equilibrium selection commonly used in entry models in the empirical literature. In addition, using supermodularity techniques, we provide novel conditions of independent interest on the primitives (demand and cost functions) of market competition to justify our assumptions for Bertrand and Cournot competition. These include results on the effects of entry and demand shifts and highlight the critical relevance of the property of log-supermodularity of demand.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们针对标准 二 阶段入门游戏提出了一种全球游戏方法。 第一 阶段的进入决策是战略替代。产品市场竞争的 第二 阶段博弈反映了一个基本的共同价值“市场吸引力”参数，企业获得关于该参数的私人噪声信号。主要结果在进入游戏中建立了独特均衡的选择，随着噪声消失，在意味着有效进入的截止策略中。这为实证文献中进入模型中常用的均衡选择提供了理论基础。此外，使用超模块化技术，我们提供了对市场竞争原语（需求和成本函数）独立感兴趣的新颖条件，以证明我们对伯特兰和古诺竞争的假设是正确的。这些包括关于进入和需求变化影响的结果，并强调需求的对数超模块化属性的关键相关性。

articles.title_en: Competitive limit of competing auctions
articles.title_cn: 竞争拍卖的竞争限制
articles.abstract_en: We study the link between strategic equilibria of competing auctions and the “competitive distribution of auctions” (Peters, 1997). With minimal restrictions on each seller’s possible costs and feasible reserve prices, we show that as the number of players increases to infinity while fixing a positive buyer-to-seller ratio, symmetric perfect Bayesian equilibria of finite markets converge to the competitive equilibrium of the large market.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究竞争性拍卖的战略均衡与“拍卖的竞争性分配”之间的联系（Peters，1997）。在对每个卖方的可能成本和可行底价的限制最小化的情况下，我们表明，随着参与者数量增加到无穷大，同时固定正的买卖双方比率，有限市场的对称完美贝叶斯均衡收敛到大市场的竞争均衡。

articles.title_en: A simultaneous analysis of turnout and voting under proportional representation: Theory and experiments
articles.title_cn: 比例代表制下投票率和投票的同步分析：理论与实验
articles.abstract_en: In a system of proportional representation, we study the interaction between a voter’s turnout decision and her party choice, and how these relate to party polarization. Models of strategic interaction with instrumental voting, such as Nash and Quantal Response, predict such interaction effects, while Naive Voting models do not. In particular, the instrumental voting models predict (i) a Polarization Effect: reduced strategic party choice when voting is voluntary makes voters more likely to vote for extreme parties (conditional on voting at all); (ii) an Extremist Effect: voters supporting extreme parties are most likely to vote; (iii) a Turnout Effect: party polarization increases voter turnout. We provide data from a laboratory experiment that provide some support for these theoretical predictions. In addition, we provide supporting empirical evidence from real-world elections. Thus, the interaction between turnout and strategic voting that has been neglected in most of the previous literature is shown to be important, as predicted by models of instrumental voting.
articles.abstract_cn: 在比例代表制中，我们研究选民的投票率决定和政党选择之间的相互作用，以及它们与政党两极分化的关系。与工具性投票的策略交互模型（例如纳什和量子响应）可以预测这种交互效应，而朴素投票模型则不能。特别是，工具性投票模型预测（i）极化效应：自愿投票时战略政党选择的减少使得选民更有可能投票给极端政党（完全以投票为条件）； (ii) 极端主义效应：支持极端政党的选民最有可能投票； (iii) 投票率效应：政党两极分化增加选民投票率。我们提供了实验室实验的数据，为这些理论预测提供了一些支持。此外，我们还提供来自现实世界选举的支持性经验证据。因此，正如工具投票模型所预测的那样，先前大多数文献中忽视的投票率和策略投票之间的相互作用被证明是重要的。

articles.title_en: Competing for influence in networks through strategic targeting
articles.title_cn: 通过战略定位争夺网络影响力
articles.abstract_en: We experimentally investigate targeting decisions in a setting where a human player competes for influence in a network against a computerized opponent with opposing views, whose targeting choice is revealed before the player acts. By varying network structure, opponent influence, and nodes opinion heterogeneity, we find that players typically adopt best-response strategies based on relative influence. However, they sometimes deviate – for example, by erroneously targeting central nodes or by avoiding the opponent’s target. Targeting is also affected by affinity and opposition biases, the strength of which depends on the initial opinion distribution. Targeting the center, avoiding the competitor’s target, or selecting nodes based on their initial opinions when these are not best responses generates significant efficiency losses.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们实验性地研究了人类玩家在网络中与持相反观点的计算机化对手竞争影响力的环境中的目标决策，其目标选择在玩家行动之前就已揭示。通过改变网络结构、对手影响力和节点意见异质性，我们发现参与者通常会根据相对影响力采取最佳响应策略。然而，它们有时会出现偏差——例如，错误地瞄准中心节点或避开对手的目标。目标定位还受到亲和力和反对偏见的影响，其强度取决于最初的意见分布。当这些不是最佳响应时，瞄准中心、避开竞争对手的目标或根据他们的初步意见选择节点会产生显着的效率损失。

articles.title_en: Potentials in social environments
articles.title_cn: 社会环境中的潜力
articles.abstract_en: We develop and extend notions of potentials for normal-form games (Monderer and Shapley, 1996) to present a unified approach for the general class of social environments. The different potentials and corresponding social environments can be ordered in terms of their permissiveness. We classify different methods to construct potentials and we characterize potentials for matching problems, vote trading, multilateral trade, TU games, and various pillage games.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发并扩展了正常形式游戏（Monderer 和 Shapley、1996）的潜力概念，为一般的社交环境提供了一种统一的方法。不同的潜力和相应的社会环境可以根据其允许程度进行排序。我们对构建势的不同方法进行了分类，并描述了匹配问题、投票交易、多边贸易、TU 博弈和各种掠夺博弈的势。

articles.title_en: Designing Heaven’s will: The job assignment in the Chinese imperial civil service
articles.title_cn: 设计天意：中国皇家文官的工作分配
articles.abstract_en: We study the evolution of entry-level civil service job assignment in imperial China from the tenth to the early twentieth century. The procedures were sequential, irrevocable, and publicly verifiable, relying increasingly on lots-drawing and operating under constraints that limited which posts candidates could fill and where they could be posted. Using a unified matching framework, we compare procedures by their ability to maximize the number of filled posts and to assign higher-ranked jobs to higher-degree candidates. We show that reforms intended to improve these outcomes can instead reverse them once constraints interact, a failure driven by greedy sequential matching. Building on the structure of the final historical procedure, we describe minimal extensions of public lots-drawing mechanisms that guarantee maximum matchings under compatibility constraints.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了从 第十 到二十世纪初中国帝制时期初级公务员工作分配的演变。这些程序是连续的、不可撤销的、可公开验证的，越来越依赖抽签，并且在限制候选人可以填补的职位和他们可以被派往的地方的限制下运作。使用统一的匹配框架，我们根据最大化填补职位数量并将较高职位分配给较高学历候选人的能力来比较程序。我们表明，一旦约束相互作用，旨在改善这些结果的改革可能会逆转它们，这是由贪婪顺序匹配导致的失败。基于最终历史程序的结构，我们描述了公共抽签机制的最小扩展，以保证兼容性约束下的最大匹配。

articles.title_en: Lucky but confident –The effect of confidence on meritocratic beliefs and preferences for redistribution
articles.title_cn: 幸运但自信——自信对功绩主义信念及再分配偏好的影响
articles.abstract_en: How does confidence in combination with success affect meritocratic beliefs and preferences for redistribution? In a large-scale real-effort competition (n = 1365), we manipulate both confidence and the outcome of the competition to provide causal evidence. First, we show that increased confidence causes successful participants to perceive outcomes as more meritocratic, while unsuccessful participants perceive outcomes as more determined by luck. Thus, increased confidence polarizes meritocratic beliefs between successful and unsuccessful individuals. Second, we find no statistically significant effect of confidence on preferences for redistribution. However, we do find that winning the competition significantly reduces the willingness to redistribute, regardless of confidence treatment. Our findings suggest that disagreements about the causes of inequality are most likely among individuals who anticipate success in a meritocratic system, and that success and failure can have large polarizing effects on preferences for redistribution.
articles.abstract_cn: 自信与成功的结合如何影响功绩主义信念及再分配偏好？在一项大规模实际努力竞赛中（样本量 = 1365），我们操控了自信和竞赛结果，以提供因果证据。第一，我们发现自信的提升使成功参与者更倾向于将结果视为功绩决定，而失败参与者则更倾向于认为结果由运气决定。因此，自信的提升加剧了成功与失败个体之间的功绩主义信念分化。第二，我们未发现自信对再分配偏好有统计显著影响。然而，我们发现无论自信处理如何，赢得竞赛显著降低了再分配意愿。我们的研究结果表明，关于不平等成因的分歧最可能出现在预期在功绩体系中成功的个体之间，且成功与失败对再分配偏好具有显著的极化效应。

articles.title_en: When information and communication are both costly
articles.title_cn: 当信息和沟通均有成本时
articles.abstract_en: I consider environments where an upwardly-biased expert faces both costs of acquiring information and of “transmitting inaccurate information relative to the realized state” (forecasting error) when advising a decision-maker. While existing models study these costs separately, I show that considering them jointly can substantially alter standard results. Introducing costly information acquisition overturns the partial-communication and language-inflation predictions of models with bounded messages and costly communication: equilibrium communication features truth-telling and full transmission of the acquired information. At the same time, communication costs can reverse the structure of optimal information acquisition, shifting from partitions with decreasing interval lengths to partitions with increasing interval lengths when misreporting is sufficiently more costly than acquisition. Finally, information acquisition costs generate an acquisition–transmission dilemma: the expert never acquires information that cannot be credibly communicated, implying that perfect information acquisition is impossible.
articles.abstract_cn: 我考虑了一个环境，其中一个存在向上偏差的专家在向决策者提供建议时，既面临获取信息的成本，也面临“相对于实现状态传递不准确信息的成本”（预测误差）。现有模型通常分别研究这两种成本，而我展示了将它们联合考虑会显著改变标准结果。引入有成本的信息获取推翻了带有有限信息和有成本沟通模型中的部分沟通和语言膨胀预测：均衡沟通表现为真实陈述和所获信息的完全传递。与此同时，当错误报告的成本远高于获取成本时，沟通成本可以逆转最优信息获取的结构，使得区间长度由递减分割转变为递增分割。最后，信息获取成本产生了获取-传递困境：专家永远不会获取无法可信传递的信息，这意味着完美信息获取是不可能的。

articles.title_en: On the existence of a strong Nash equilibrium under the efficiency-adjusted deferred acceptance mechanism
articles.title_cn: 关于效率调整延迟接受机制下强纳什均衡的存在性
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies a preference revelation game induced by the Efficiency-Adjusted Deferred Acceptance (EDA) mechanism in a priority-based allocation problem. The main findings are: (i) we show the existence of a strong Nash equilibrium under EDA through a simple algorithm; (ii) the equilibrium outcome from the algorithm coincides with the outcome of the Top Trading Cycles mechanism; and (iii) the strategy profile found by the algorithm is also a strictly strong Nash equilibrium in the game induced by the Deferred Acceptance mechanism.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了优先级分配问题中由效率调整延迟接受（EDA）机制引发的偏好揭示博弈。主要发现包括：(i) 我们通过一个简单算法证明了EDA机制下强纳什均衡的存在性；(ii) 该算法得到的均衡结果与顶级交易环机制的结果一致；(iii) 该算法找到的策略组合在由延迟接受机制引发的博弈中也是严格强纳什均衡。

articles.title_en: Substitutes for nonunitary many-to-many matching with contracts
articles.title_cn: 非单元多对多匹配合同的替代性
articles.abstract_en: We consider many-to-many matching with contracts where each agent can sign multiple contracts with the same agent. In other words, the unitarity condition is not assumed in this model. We offer a weaker substitutability condition called substitutability across doctors, which is a generalization of unilateral substitutability. We show that if every hospital’s choice function satisfies substitutability across doctors and every doctor’s choice function is responsive, then a stable outcome exists. We establish this result by generalizing the cumulative offer process. Moreover, we propose an even weaker substitutability condition that incorporates observability of doctors’ contract offers during the algorithm. The same algorithm guarantees the existence of a stable outcome even when substitutability across doctors is replaced with the weaker condition. We additionally present a specific class of choice functions satisfying the weaker condition that can be applied to a temporary staffing market, particularly in which temp agencies may assign multiple temporary workers to each client.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑多对多匹配合同模型，其中每个代理可以与同一代理签订多个合同。换言之，该模型不假设单元性条件。我们提出了一种较弱的替代性条件，称为跨医生替代性，这是单边替代性的推广。我们证明，如果每个医院的选择函数满足跨医生替代性且每个医生的选择函数是响应性的，则存在稳定结果。我们通过推广累积报价过程来建立该结果。此外，我们提出了一种更弱的替代性条件，该条件结合了算法过程中医生合同报价的可观测性。即使将跨医生替代性替换为该更弱条件，同一算法仍保证稳定结果的存在。我们还展示了一类满足该更弱条件的特定选择函数，可应用于临时用工市场，特别是临时中介机构可能向每个客户分配多个临时工的情形。

articles.title_en: Two-player binary global games without dominance solvable states
articles.title_cn: 无优势可解状态下的二-玩家二元全球博弈
articles.abstract_en: We extend global games à la Carlsson and van Damme (1993) to environments where the risk-dominant equilibrium is selected even if there is no dominance solvable game in the underlying class of games. Strict dominance can emerge in the global game from strategic uncertainty due to discrete payoff changes in underlying games, and we provide sufficient conditions on payoff changes that warrant iterated dominance of the risk-dominant equilibrium. Thus, strategic uncertainty creates strictly dominant actions as well as fostering iterated dominance, in contrast to global games hitherto where strategic uncertainty does only the latter. Discrete payoff changes tend to arise, in particular, in situations where a public good can be provided with varying degrees of coordination depending on the state, so that coordinating actions can be strategic substitutes and free-riding incentives are present. We illustrate our findings in a stylized public good provision model.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将Carlsson和van Damme (1993) 的全球博弈扩展到即使在基础博弈类别中不存在优势可解博弈时也能选择风险优势均衡的环境中。由于基础博弈中离散的收益变化，战略不确定性可能在全球博弈中产生严格优势，且我们提供了关于收益变化的充分条件，以保证风险优势均衡的迭代优势。因此，战略不确定性不仅创造了严格优势行为，还促进了迭代优势，这与迄今为止的全球博弈中战略不确定性仅促进后者的情况形成对比。离散收益变化尤其倾向于出现在公共物品可根据状态以不同协调程度提供的情形中，此时协调行为可能是战略替代品且存在搭便车激励。我们在一个程式化的公共物品提供模型中说明了我们的发现。

articles.title_en: Persuasion of interacting receivers
articles.title_cn: 相互作用接收者的劝说
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates how to persuade multiple interacting receivers under arbitrary equilibrium selection and when receivers’ preferences may exhibit psychological traits. Our main result characterizes the conditions under which the sender can categorize information using partitions and then disclose partition-related information without altering the equilibrium outcome. This finding broadens the traditional direct approach based on the revelation principle, which categorizes messages solely by equilibrium actions. Consequently, our results support a generalized direct approach, which we apply to study information disclosure in fostering fairness within groups where members may demonstrate altruistic behaviors.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在任意均衡选择下以及接收者偏好可能表现出心理特征时，如何劝说多个相互作用的接收者。我们的主要结果刻画了发送者在何种条件下可以使用划分对信息进行分类，然后披露与划分相关的信息而不改变均衡结果。该发现拓展了基于启示原理的传统直接方法，后者仅通过均衡行为对信息进行分类。因此，我们的结果支持一种广义的直接方法，并将其应用于研究在成员可能表现出利他行为的群体中促进公平的信息披露。

articles.title_en: The evolution of strategies in repeated 2 × 2 anti-coordination games
articles.title_cn: 重复2×2反协调博弈中策略的演化
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the evolution of strategies in repeated 2 x 2 anti-coordination games. Turn-taking is advantageous against strategies that consistently choose the same stage-game action, provided the discount factor is sufficiently high or the payoff asymmetry in coordination is sufficiently low. However, it becomes vulnerable when the set of strategies allowed to invade is expanded. Nonetheless, if the matching process exhibits a high degree of assortativity, turn-taking regains robustness as long as it promotes efficiency.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了重复2×2反协调博弈中策略的演化。轮流行动在面对始终选择相同阶段博弈行动的策略时具有优势，前提是折现因子足够高或协调中的收益不对称性足够低。然而，当允许入侵的策略集合扩大时，轮流行动变得脆弱。尽管如此，如果匹配过程表现出高度的同类相配性，只要轮流行动促进效率，它就能重新获得稳健性。

articles.title_en: Authority measure for opinion dynamics
articles.title_cn: 舆论动态中的权威度量
articles.abstract_en: We propose a formal framework for measuring the authority of individuals in opinion dynamics. Our framework is based on an axiomatic foundation in the tradition of coalitional game theory. We show that the unique solution concept satisfying our axioms is a generalization of the “authority distribution” notion of Hu and Shapley. Our approach is based on the dynamics of opinion exchange rather than on network topology. However, for any fixed opinion dynamics, our authority concept associates a network centrality measure with any given network topology. Earlier as well as new network centrality measures are obtained in this way.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个用于衡量舆论动态中个体权威性的形式化框架。该框架基于联盟博弈理论传统中的公理基础。我们证明，满足这些公理的唯一解概念是胡和沙普利“权威分布”概念的推广。我们的方法基于舆论交换的动态过程，而非网络拓扑结构。然而，对于任何固定的舆论动态，我们的权威概念都能将任意给定的网络拓扑关联到一个网络中心性度量。通过这种方式，可以获得既有的以及新的网络中心性度量。

articles.title_en: The effort-maximizing move order in tullock contests
articles.title_cn: 图洛克竞赛中的努力最大化出手顺序
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines effort-maximizing move orders in two-player Tullock contests across varying levels of contest accuracy and player asymmetries. Unlike prior work that favors strong-lead sequential formats in lottery contests, our analysis demonstrates that all three formats—strong-lead, weak-lead, and simultaneous—can be optimal in the general Tullock contests. Strong-lead contests are most effective in noisy environments, but lose their advantage as contest accuracy increases. Weak-lead contests may become optimal when the weaker player successfully preempts. Simultaneous-move contests tend to perform better as the players’ ability differences become less severe. Overall, the optimal contest design jointly depends on the contest accuracy levels and relative strengths of the contestants.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了在不同竞赛准确度和参与者非对称性水平下，二玩家图洛克竞赛中的努力最大化出手顺序。与以往偏好强先手顺序格式的彩票竞赛研究不同，我们的分析表明，在一般图洛克竞赛中，所有三格式——强先手、弱先手和同时出手——均可能是最优的。强先手竞赛在噪声环境中最为有效，但随着竞赛准确度的提高，其优势减弱。弱先手竞赛在较弱玩家成功抢先时可能成为最优选择。随着玩家能力差异减小，同时出手竞赛表现趋于更优。总体而言，最优竞赛设计取决于竞赛准确度水平和参赛者相对实力的共同作用。

articles.title_en: Strategic formation of production networks
articles.title_cn: 生产网络的战略形成
articles.abstract_en: We provide a strategic model of the formation of production networks that subsumes the standard general equilibrium approach. The objective of firms in our setting is to choose their supply relationships so as to maximize their profit at the general equilibrium that unfolds. We show that this objective is equivalent to the maximization by the firms of their eigenvector centrality in the production network. As is common in network formation games based on centrality, there are multiple Nash equilibria in our setting. We have investigated the characteristics and social efficiency of these equilibria in a stylized version of our model representing international trade networks. We show that the impact of network structure on social welfare is firstly determined by a trade-off between costs of increasing process complexity and positive spillovers on productivity induced by the diversification of the input mix. We further analyze a variant of our model that accounts for the risks of disruption of supply relationships. In this setting, we characterize how social welfare depends on the structure of the production network, the spatial distribution of risks, and the process of shock aggregation in supply chains. We finally show that simple trade policies characterized by sets of links that are either prevented or catalyzed can be a powerful equilibrium selection device.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个生产网络形成的战略模型，该模型涵盖了标准的一般均衡方法。在我们的设定中，企业的目标是选择其供应关系，以最大化其在所形成的一般均衡中的利润。我们证明了这一目标等同于企业最大化其在生产网络中的特征向量中心性。正如基于中心性的网络形成博弈中常见的那样，我们的设定中存在多个纳什均衡。我们在一个代表国际贸易网络的模型简化版本中，研究了这些均衡的特征及其社会效率。我们表明，网络结构对社会福利的影响首先取决于增加流程复杂性的成本与由投入组合多样化引起的生产率正向溢出之间的权衡。我们进一步分析了一个考虑供应关系中断风险的模型变体。在该设定中，我们刻画了社会福利如何依赖于生产网络结构、风险的空间分布以及供应链中冲击聚合的过程。最后，我们展示了通过阻止或促进特定链接的简单贸易政策，可以成为一种强有力的均衡选择机制。

articles.title_en: A model of participatory persuasion
articles.title_cn: 参与式说服模型
articles.abstract_en: This paper introduces the concept of participatory persuasion in autocracies, where regimes use controlled communication to sustain their rule. In an overlapping-generations model of democratization, we show that the regime’s survival can be prolonged when citizens communicate within small circles compared to a setting in which communication is entirely absent. Paradoxically, limited freedom of speech enhances the regime’s persuasion by turning citizens into inadvertent agents of state propaganda. We further extend the analysis to settings with homophily or under state censorship.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文引入了专制政体中参与式说服的概念，即政权通过受控的沟通维持其统治。在一个重叠世代的民主化模型中，我们展示了当公民在小圈子内交流时，相较于完全缺乏沟通的情形，政权的存续时间可以被延长。矛盾的是，有限的言论自由通过将公民转变为无意中的国家宣传代理人，增强了政权的说服力。我们进一步将分析扩展到具有同质性或处于国家审查环境下的情形。

articles.title_en: Delay in social learning
articles.title_cn: 社会学习中的延迟
articles.abstract_en: We study a class of social learning games in which players choose whether and when to make an irreversible investment. We ask whether the option value of learning induces delay. Surprisingly, under natural and standard assumptions, delay does not arise in equilibrium. Although waiting even momentarily would yield informative observations, we show that this learning is payoff-irrelevant. As a result, players either invest immediately or not at all.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一类社会学习博弈，其中参与者选择是否以及何时进行不可逆投资。我们探讨了学习的期权价值是否会导致延迟。令人惊讶的是，在自然且标准的假设下，均衡中并不存在延迟。尽管即使短暂等待也会产生有信息的观察，但我们证明这种学习对收益无关紧要。因此，参与者要么立即投资，要么根本不投资。

articles.title_en: Caps on bids in all-pay contests with identity-dependent externalities
articles.title_cn: 具有身份依赖外部性的全额支付竞赛中的出价上限
articles.abstract_en: This article examines, both theoretically and experimentally, the welfare implications of implementing symmetric bid caps in lobbying competitions. We model lobbying games as lottery contests with two radicals and one centrist, where all players strictly prefer to win. However, if they lose, radicals prefer to lose to a centrist rather than to the opposing radical. We establish the existence and uniqueness of equilibrium and find that, in the absence of a bid cap, radicals may bid aggressively enough to drive the centrist out of the competition, thereby preventing the social welfare-maximizing outcome. Consequently, implementing a bid cap enhances social welfare in two ways: it reduces aggregate expenditure and increases the likelihood of the centrist winning. Our experimental results qualitatively align with the theoretical predictions. However, we also identify and address notable behavioral patterns: in contrast to the vast experimental literature (Sheremeta, 2013) on contests, aggregate bids do not exceed theoretical predictions in all treatments.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文从理论和实验两个角度考察了在游说竞争中实施对称出价上限的福利影响。我们将游说博弈建模为包含二名激进派和一名中间派的抽签竞赛，所有参与者均严格偏好获胜。然而，若失败，激进派更倾向于输给中间派而非对立激进派。我们证明了均衡的存在性和唯一性，发现若无出价上限，激进派可能出价过于激进，导致中间派被挤出竞争，从而阻碍社会福利最大化结果的实现。因此，实施出价上限通过二种方式提升社会福利：降低总支出并增加中间派获胜的可能性。我们的实验结果在定性上与理论预测一致，但也发现并解决了显著的行为模式：与大量竞赛实验文献（Sheremeta，2013）不同，所有处理中的总出价均未超过理论预测。

articles.title_en: Transparency and information acquisition in college admissions
articles.title_cn: 大学录取中的透明度与信息获取
articles.abstract_en: We theoretically and experimentally study centralized college admissions in which colleges evaluate students under a ‘translucent’ admission system and students can learn each college’s suitability through costly information acquisition. In centralized matching via Gale and Shapley’s deferred acceptance algorithm, students decide whether to acquire information before submitting their rank-order lists. However, uncertainty about the final assignment lowers the expected gain from learning, thereby reducing social welfare, compared to a scenario without such uncertainty. Our experiments demonstrate that the welfare loss is greater with more opaque admission systems. The empirical social welfare obtained in our experimental treatments is consistently lower than the theoretical welfare, and we identify non-equilibrium learning as a main contributor.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们从理论和实验两个角度研究了集中式大学录取，在该录取系统中，大学在“半透明”录取制度下评估学生，学生则通过付出成本的信息获取来了解各大学的适合度。在通过Gale和Shapley的延迟接受算法进行的集中匹配中，学生决定是否在提交排名列表前获取信息。然而，关于最终分配的不确定性降低了学习的预期收益，从而相比于无此类不确定性的情形降低了社会福利。我们的实验表明，录取制度越不透明，福利损失越大。实验处理中的经验社会福利始终低于理论福利，我们确定非均衡学习是主要原因之一。

articles.title_en: Eliciting and distinguishing between weak and incomplete preferences: Theory, experiment and computation
articles.title_cn: 引出并区分弱偏好与不完全偏好：理论、实验与计算
articles.abstract_en: We propose an experimental design and data-analytic method for eliciting and distinguishing the strict-preference, indifference, and indecisiveness components of individual preferences in general choice environments. The design combines a forced-choice treatment with a free-choice treatment. In both treatments, subjects may select multiple alternatives from a menu. In the free-choice treatment, subjects may also avoid or delay choice at a small expected cost. To analyze such data, we extend a standard non-parametric goodness-of-fit criterion to accommodate multi-valued choices. We apply it to evaluate the consistency of subjects’ 50 decisions with utility maximization and two models of incomplete-preference maximization. Around 55% of subjects are well explained by one of these models, with 33% and 22% best explained by utility and incomplete-preference maximization, respectively. Revealed preferences typically feature non-trivial indifferences, and those that are incomplete often exhibit the predicted theoretical distinctions between indifference and indecisiveness, which are documented empirically for the first time.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种实验设计和数据分析方法，用于在一般选择环境中引出并区分个体偏好的严格偏好、无差异和犹豫成分。该设计结合了强制选择处理和自由选择处理。在两种处理中，受试者均可从菜单中选择多个备选项。在自由选择处理中，受试者还可以以较小的预期成本避免或延迟选择。为分析此类数据，我们扩展了标准的非参数拟合优度准则，以适应多值选择。我们将其应用于评估受试者的50决策与效用最大化及不完全偏好最大化的二模型的一致性。约55%的受试者被这些模型中的一良好解释，其中33%和22%分别由效用最大化和不完全偏好最大化最佳解释。揭示的偏好通常具有非平凡的无差异，而不完全偏好常表现出理论上预测的无差异与犹豫之间的区别，这些区别在第一时间段内得到了实证记录。

articles.title_en: Information manipulation of wishful thinkers
articles.title_cn: 愿望性思维者的信息操控
articles.abstract_en: Digital platforms may manipulate customer reviews to impede other consumers from acquiring accurate information and to increase sales. In a rational inattention setting where consumers acquire information about product quality before making purchasing decisions, we show that the platform has incentives to restrict information acquisition in the presence of consumers with wishful thinking. These biased consumers are unaware of their bias and weigh any good news about the product quality more heavily than a Bayesian consumer. We identify the conditions under which the firm optimally constrains information acquisition, and characterize when competition can alleviate this type of exploitation. Our results extend to a broader class of non-Bayesian rules beyond wishful thinking.
articles.abstract_cn: 数字平台可能操控客户评价，以阻碍其他消费者获取准确信息并增加销售额。在一个理性忽视的框架下，消费者在做出购买决策前获取关于产品质量的信息，我们证明在存在愿望性思维消费者的情况下，平台有激励限制信息获取。这些有偏消费者未意识到其偏见，并且对任何关于产品质量的好消息赋予比贝叶斯消费者更高的权重。我们确定了企业最优限制信息获取的条件，并刻画了竞争何时能够缓解此类剥削。我们的结果可推广至愿望性思维之外更广泛的非贝叶斯规则类别。

articles.title_en: Cheap talk and lie detection
articles.title_cn: 廉价言语与谎言检测
articles.abstract_en: This study analyzes strategic interactions between cheap talk and lie detection, identifies the receiver-optimal equilibrium under costly lie detection, and evaluates its effectiveness. An informed sender seeks to persuade an uninformed receiver to choose higher actions, while the receiver aims to align the action as closely as possible with the true state. The sender issues a claim about the state, and the receiver then decides whether to incur a cost to inspect the claim’s truthfulness. We show that the receiver-optimal equilibrium partitions the state space into three intervals. Types in the upper interval make precise and truthful claims, which are mimicked by types in the lower interval and are subject to random inspection. Types in the middle interval make a vague claim that is never inspected. We further show that lie detection is more beneficial to the receiver than direct state verification, as it creates incentives for moderate and high types to communicate truthfully.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了廉价言语与谎言检测之间的战略互动，确定了在有成本的谎言检测下接收者最优均衡，并评估其有效性。一位知情的发送者试图说服一位不知情的接收者选择更高的行动，而接收者旨在使行动尽可能接近真实状态。发送者发布关于状态的声明，接收者随后决定是否支付成本以检查声明的真实性。我们表明，接收者最优均衡将状态空间划分为若干区间。上区间的类型做出精确且真实的声明，下区间的类型模仿上区间的声明并受到随机检查。中间区间的类型做出模糊声明，且从不被检查。我们进一步表明，谎言检测比直接状态验证对接收者更有利，因为它激励中等和高类型的发送者进行真实沟通。

articles.title_en: Competition in persuasion in the attention economy
articles.title_cn: 注意力经济中的说服竞争
articles.abstract_en: Gentzkow and Kamenica (2016) show that competition among senders benefits receivers if and only if the information environment is Blackwell-connected. This paper shows that introducing receivers’ limited attention and heterogeneous beliefs can overturn this result. Even in a Blackwell-connected information environment, information revelation may be lower under duopoly than under monopoly. Indeed, limited attention may incentivize receivers to sort into the audiences of like-minded senders. In turn, this adverse sorting can make it optimal for senders to reveal less information.
articles.abstract_cn: Gentzkow 和 Kamenica（2016）表明，只有在信息环境是 Blackwell 连通的情况下，发送者之间的竞争才会使接收者受益。本文表明，引入接收者的有限注意力和异质信念可能推翻这一结果。即使在 Blackwell 连通的信息环境下，双头垄断下的信息揭示也可能低于垄断下的水平。事实上，有限的注意力可能激励接收者分流到志同道合的发送者受众中。反过来，这种不利的分流可能使发送者选择揭示更少信息成为最优策略。
